title: NDJSON end line
description: The last line of every NDJSON answer, and the JSON of the `atlas:end` metadata of an Arrow stream's final zero-row batch (§9.6.5). A body that ends without it is incomplete: upstream_failed. A problem after the first row is reported here; output_limit_exceeded with `truncated` is a warning, any other problem is raised after the rows (Q-DOC-15).

truncated.description: Whether the answer was cut at the caller's output cap.
